groups.defect: Delegating to useAllRulerRuleAbilities drops federated-group detection, allowing mutation abilities previously blocked by immutability.
groups.rationale: All three report the same lost federation check and hardcoded false value. Preserving the federation signal in the ability computation addresses all three.

groups.defect: The optional rule prop is passed to a hook requiring RulerRuleDTO, and non-Grafana prom-only inputs silently lose the actions block when identifier construction fails.
groups.rationale: Both explicitly report the optional-rule hook contract mismatch. s_9d5d3468 additionally reports the unhandled prom-only input case returning null, which must survive consolidation.

groups.defect: The GrafanaRuleListItem rendered in FilterView's map lacks a stable React key.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same dropped key prop and resulting reconciliation problems. Restoring key={key} resolves both reports.
